user.title: New tariff period
user.description: Prices in force from the given date until the next period. All values include VAT and taxes; the integration README explains how to work them out.

data.prezzo_sc1: Variable price (€/Smc, VAT and taxes included) – up to 120 Smc/year
data.prezzo_sc2: Variable price (€/Smc, VAT and taxes included) – 121 to 480 Smc/year
data.prezzo_sc3: Variable price (€/Smc, VAT and taxes included) – over 480 Smc/year

data_description.dal: Date from which these prices apply.
data_description.prezzo_sc1: Sum of all per-cubic-meter items: gas, transport and meter management, system charges, excise and regional surcharge, plus VAT. It is NOT the bill total divided by the Smc: the total also includes the fixed fees, entered separately.
data_description.prezzo_sc2: If empty, the price of the previous bracket is used. It changes mostly because of excise and regional surcharge.
data_description.prezzo_sc3: If empty, the price of the previous bracket is used. Above 480 Smc VAT rises from 10% to 22%.
data_description.quota_fissa: Sum of the monthly fixed fees (sales, transport, system charges), with 22% VAT. It is spread day by day.

data.distribuzione: Consumption distribution in the Energy dashboard

data_description.intervallo_ore: How often to check the portal for new readings. Smart meters are read about once a month: 12 hours is plenty.
data_description.coefficiente: Coefficient C shown on your gas bill (depends on the municipality: altitude and climate zone). Converts the cubic meters read by the meter into the standard cubic meters (Smc) you are billed for.
data_description.distribuzione: Readings arrive about once a month: the consumption between two readings can be spread over the single days or shown entirely on the reading day.
data_description.sensore_temperatura: Only needed for the degree-day distribution. Requires a sensor with long-term statistics (state_class: measurement); days without data use the uniform distribution.
data_description.statistica_smc: Exports to the Energy dashboard the volumes already multiplied by coefficient C, so totals match the Smc on your bill. Off: cubic meters read by the meter.

error.sensore_richiesto: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor for the degree-day distribution.

options.giornaliera: Evenly over the days between two readings (recommended)
options.gradi_giorno: Over the days between two readings, by heating degree days (outdoor temperature)

coefficiente.title: Coefficient C
coefficiente.description: Enter the coefficient C shown on the gas bill of {nome} (usually between 0.95 and 1.02). It is needed to compute Smc and costs correctly. If your coefficient really is 1, you can ignore this issue.
